description: Source code for alarm management in an AUTOSAR platform, including functions for getting, setting, and canceling alarms, as well as alarm processing and autostart logic.

methods.name: GetAlarmBase
methods.description: Reads the alarm base characteristics, returning information about the alarm base.

methods.name: GetAlarm
methods.description: Returns the relative time in ticks before an alarm expires.

methods.name: SetRelAlarm
methods.description: Sets a relative alarm with specified increment and cycle.

methods.name: SetAbsAlarm
methods.description: Sets an absolute alarm to trigger at a specific start time with optional cycle.

methods.name: AlarmProcess
methods.description: Processes an alarm upon expiration, updating its active status and scheduling next expiration if cyclic.

methods.name: Os_AlarmCheck
methods.description: Checks alarms against counter value and triggers associated actions.

methods.name: Os_AlarmAutostart
methods.description: Automatically starts alarms based on autostart configuration and application mode.
